description: This file defines types, classes, and functions for handling test reporting and result serialization in the Playwright testing framework. It includes classes for managing test suites, test cases, test results, and a receiver class for processing JSON-based test events.

classes.name: TeleReporterReceiver
classes.description: Handles incoming JSON test events, manages test suite and test case hierarchy, and communicates with a reporter interface.

classes.name: TeleSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, which can contain nested suites and test cases.

classes.name: TeleTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case with its results, annotations, and metadata.

classes.name: TeleTestStep
classes.description: Represents a step within a test result, including timing, errors, and attachments.

classes.name: TeleTestResult
classes.description: Stores the outcome and associated data of a test execution, including status, errors, and attachments.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Routes incoming JSON events to appropriate handler methods based on event method type.

methods.name: _onConfigure
methods.description: Handles configuration setup from JSON event.

methods.name: _onProject
methods.description: Processes project-related JSON event, updating test suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _onBegin
methods.description: Signals the start of test execution.

methods.name: _onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test result.

methods.name: _onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles a paused test state with errors.

methods.name: _onTestEnd
methods.description: Processes the end of a test, recording results and attachments.

methods.name: _onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a test step.

methods.name: _onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step.

methods.name: _onAttach
methods.description: Handles attachment data for a test result.

methods.name: _onError
methods.description: Processes an error event.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Handles standard I/O data for a test result.

methods.name: _onEnd
methods.description: Signals the end of test run and finalizes reporting.

methods.name: _onExit
methods.description: Handles process exit event.

methods.name: _parseConfig
methods.description: Converts JSON config to internal full config format.

methods.name: _parseProject
methods.description: Converts JSON project data into internal project representation.

methods.name: _parseAttachments
methods.description: Converts JSON attachments to internal format, decoding base64 if needed.

methods.name: _mergeSuiteInto
methods.description: Merges JSON suite data into internal suite hierarchy.

methods.name: _mergeTestInto
methods.description: Merges JSON test case data into internal test case objects.

methods.name: _updateTest
methods.description: Updates test case properties based on JSON data.

methods.name: _absoluteLocation
methods.description: Converts relative location paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: _absolutePath
methods.description: Resolves relative paths to absolute paths based on root directory.
